description.en:
Makes a character look at something. The look-at state is a setting of the character's head (it turns to look at a target).
- mode 0: switches the look-at on with its default target (what that target is was not traced; the events use it on the player's character).
- mode 2: looks at the point (x, y, z) given after the mode.
Other modes do nothing. CMND_RESET_LOOK_AT switches it off.

null once set; false if the character is not found.
null too if mode 2 is given without the three coordinates, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
